newsitem.title: USA: Ethan Allen sees Q2 eps at $0.79-$0.81 a shr.
newsitem.headline: Ethan Allen sees Q2 eps at $0.79-$0.81 a shr.

text.p: Ethan Allen Interiors Inc said it expects to earn between $0.79 and $0.81 per share in its second-quarter ended December 31, compared with $0.54 per share in the year-ago period.
The Danbury, Connecticut-based furniture retailer said the earnings came on revenue of between $11.5 million and $11.8 million, compared with $7.8 million a year ago.
The company said the higher results stem from improved manufacturing, distribution and retail efficiencies.
The company sells its items through a network of more than 287 stores, 57 of which it owns, it said.
